decision.explanation: Different from every known condition. Gain-centered Welch distances rank C03 (3.625 dB) and C04 (3.717 dB) ahead of C01 (6.416 dB) and C02 (7.061 dB), but neither nearest distance is markedly below its reference separation of 3.038 dB. The figures and measurements instead show Q01 as a hybrid pattern: C02-like 60.97% sub-100-Hz power and 0.2494-ms periodicity, combined with a shifted 16.161/16.232-kHz ridge and a distinct 183.8-Hz line. C02 provides the strongest physical-pattern support, but its spectral-shape distance is worst and its absolute-frequency/detail differences preclude a broadly similar assignment. All reports have matched 10-s duration, 44.1-kHz sampling, 0.1-Hz FFT and 43.07-Hz Welch spacing, so these differences are not coverage or resolution artifacts; absolute FS levels remain secondary because acquisition gain is unknown.
